name: Court McGee
summary: The TUF 11 winner in his hometown retirement fight: technically sound, naturally strong, durable in his prime, without knockout power. Now 42 with some recent KO losses.

how_they_fight.Grappling: Strong grappler; submitted Tim Means in round one in Utah in 2024.
how_they_fight.Defense & durability: KO'd by Matt Brown and Jeremiah Wells (2022-23).

keys_to_beat: Keep it standing and hit him clean
